author: The Current
description:
Watch Alan Sparhawk with Trampled by Turtles perform "Heaven" at The Fitzgerald Theater
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Alan Sparhawk joined forces with fellow Duluth band Trampled by Turtles on a new album, called 'Alan Sparhawk with Trampled by Turtles,' released May 30, 2025. The collaboration was a project born organically out of support and friendship, as Sparhawk navigated loss and grief. 

Alan Sparhawk and Trampled by Turtles celebrated their 2025 collaborative album with a heartfelt performance at the Fitzgerald Theater in St. Paul on Dec. 11, 2025. The Current captured the entire show on video and will release it in full on Friday, May 29, to mark the one-year anniversary of ‘Alan Sparhawk with Trampled by Turtles.’ Watch a performance of "Heaven" above.

Musicians
Alan Sparhawk – vocals, guitar 
Dave Simonett – guitar, lead vocals, harmonica

Alan Sparhawk and Trampled by Turtles celebrated their 2025 collaborative album with a heartfelt performance at the Fitzgerald Theater in St. Paul on Dec. 11, 2025. The second song they performed that evening was this powerful ballad, “Heaven.” 

The Current captured the entire show on video and released it in full on Friday, May 29, to mark the one-year anniversary of the album, ‘Alan Sparhawk with Trampled by Turtles.’ Experience this special night by watching the full concert here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=e40UokjC8pQ
